answer: Continuous co-signature chains: every agent's actions must be co-signed by two peers reached via a random whisper gossip thread each epoch. Honest peers co-sign freely since signatures cost negligible compute, but a clone must sustain that thread across many independent agents who each verify the voyage of prior signatures, multiplying coordination overhead per identity. Faking a cohort means paying persistent bandwidth and latency for every synthetic node, so duplication costs more than one honest identity's routine upkeep.
